question: Show the GSD compliance rate by age band.

question: Show the GSD compliance rate by clinic, worst first.
sql: SELECT `Clinic`, MEASURE(`Eligible Patients`) AS eligible, MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics GROUP BY `Clinic` ORDER BY rate ASC

question: What is the GSD poor glycemic control rate (A1c > 9)?

question: What is the KED compliance rate and its eGFR and uACR components?

question: How many patients have a KED care gap?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ked_care_gaps FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked WHERE status = 'NOT_MET'

question: Compare all six diabetes quality measure compliance rates.
sql: SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', MEASURE(`KED Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.ked_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', MEASURE(`BPD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.bpd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', MEASURE(`SPD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.spd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', MEASURE(`EED Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.eed_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'SSD', MEASURE(`SSD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.ssd_compliance_metrics ORDER BY measure

content: This agent answers questions about six HEDIS diabetes quality measures (HEDIS-aligned demo, not NCQA-certified): GSD, KED, BPD, SPD, EED, and SSD.
For measure RATES, query the matching metric view (gsd/ked/bpd/spd/eed/ssd_compliance_metrics) using MEASURE(`<measure name>`), e.g. MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`). Never SUM or AVG a rate column.

Every compliance metric view has dimensions Measurement Year, Compliance Status, Clinic, Panel, Gap Reason, Age Band, Measure. To break a rate down by site, GROUP BY `Clinic`; to explain care gaps, GROUP BY `Gap Reason` (it shows 'Met' for compliant patients).
GSD = Glycemic Status Assessment: diabetics aged 18-75 with an A1c test in the measurement year. Also exposes Poor Control Rate (A1c > 9).
KED = Kidney Health Evaluation: diabetics aged 18-85 with BOTH an eGFR and a uACR test; uACR is usually the limiting component (see Gap Reason).
BPD = Blood Pressure control: diabetics aged 18-75 whose most recent BP reading is <140/90. Gap Reason distinguishes 'no reading' from 'not controlled'.
SPD = Statin Therapy: diabetics aged 40-75 dispensed a statin in the measurement year.
EED = Eye Exam: diabetics aged 18-75 with a retinal/diabetic eye exam in the measurement year.

SSD = Diabetes Screening for People on Antipsychotics: this is a SEPARATE cohort (serious mental illness + antipsychotic dispensing, ages 18-64), NOT the diabetes cohort. Numerator is a glucose or HbA1c screen.
For patient-level detail or care gaps, use gold_adherence_<measure>. status = 'NOT_MET' means a care gap; 'MET' means compliant. clinic_id / panel_id are on every gold table.
The diabetes cohort is defined by subsumption over the ICD-10-CM hierarchy (diagnoses under E10/E11/E13).
